title: All the information you should know before traveling to Ukraine
content:

Ukraine  Ukraine In Eastern Europe lies the Republic of Ukraine, the second largest country on the European continent, which was affiliated with the Soviet Union for decades and gained its independence in 1991. 42.7 million people live in the country, most of whom profess Eastern Orthodox Christianity, which has greatly influenced Ukrainian architecture, literature, and art. Ukraine has become one of the wonderful tourist destinations in the region due to its stunning natural landscapes, ancient monuments, and beautiful tourist areas. Do you need a visa to enter Ukraine? Citizens of the Emirates and Qatar do not need an entry visa to visit Ukraine.  As for citizens of the rest of the Gulf countries, they need an electronic visa, which is easy to obtain through The official website of the Ukrainian Foreign Ministry As for the rest of the countries, the entry visa can be obtained through the Ukrainian embassies in their countries or the countries that represent them. As Ukraine does not belong to the Schengen countries, it cannot be entered with a Schengen visa.  What is the best time to visit Ukraine?  Ukraine has a humid continental climate that makes its four seasons the most beautiful, and tourists can visit it all year round depending on the season they like. Most tourists often visit the country during the summer, when the average temperature is 26 degrees Celsius with little rain, which makes walking around and exploring the country enjoyable. If you are one of the tourists looking for tranquility and low prices, October is considered one of the best times as the number of tourists begins to decrease, which affects the prices and makes them decrease as well. You can enjoy the tourist places and historical monuments and relax on the beaches away from crowding. As for lovers of snow and the cold European atmosphere, they often like to visit Ukraine in the winter for skiing and mountain climbing, as well as to attend Christmas and New Year celebrations and shopping in the Christmas markets. As for the spring season, it is considered one of the seasons in which heavy rain falls and the number of tourists decreases, which causes those in charge of the tourism sector to reduce prices to encourage visitors to come to Ukraine. How to get to Ukraine? Tourists from the Middle East and Arab countries arrive in Ukraine by flying to a number of airports available in Ukraine, such as Kyiv International Airport, which is considered one of the best airports in the country as it receives many flights from all over the world. It is also possible to move internally between cities by flight, as there are Ukrainian international airlines and many other airline companies that have recently been serving domestic flights between cities, some of which are seasonal and permanent. Emirates Airlines connects Dubai to the capital, Kyiv, and Addissa via direct flights. Best places to stay in Ukraine There are many luxury hotels and resorts in Ukraine in most of its cities, especially in the capital, Kiev, where you can stay in five-star hotels such as the Hilton, Fairmont Grand, InterContinental, Hyatt Regency and others. There are also other options of four- and three-star categories and daily apartments that suit the budgets of all travelers. The best tourist places in Ukraine Ukraine is considered among the most beautiful tourist destinations in Europe, as its cities have many features that attract tourists from all over the world, such as picturesque nature, historical monuments, tourist attractions, hotel facilities, etc.: Kyiv city Kyiv The Ukrainian capital and the largest city and one of the most wonderful Ukrainian cities, as it has a large number of churches such as Saint Sophia Cathedral and the Kiev Lavra complex of churches, as well as palaces and museums such as the National Museum of Art and the Museum of the History of Ukraine  in addition to parks such as the Central Botanical Garden and the Landscape District and other beautiful landmarks. Kiev also has a good number of luxury hotels and resorts that include high-level facilities and services. Tourist shopping enthusiasts will find what they are looking for in various shops, malls and shopping streets that sell everything that comes to mind. city Odessa Odessa The Pearl of the Black Sea The city of Odessa is located on the coast of the Black Sea and is considered among the most beautiful Ukrainian cities, where tourists come to relax in its picturesque beaches, such as Langron Beach, which is considered one of the most important beaches in the region due to its proximity to the city center and enjoying its warm climate, as well as visiting its historical landmarks and tourist places such as the famous Opera House, which is distinguished by its wonderful design and beautiful decorations, the famous Deribas Street in the center of the city, and the bustling and beautiful Arcadia area. Lviv city (Lvov) Lviv The city of Lviv is located in the western side of Ukraine. It is bordered to the north by Volyn and to the south by Zakarpattia. To the east, it is bordered by Ternopil and Ivano-Frankivsk. It is also bordered to the west by Poland. Lviv's area is estimated at 21,833 km², about 3.61% of the total area of Ukraine. Lvov is considered one of the cultural centers in Ukraine. The city was founded at the beginning of the year 1200 during the reign of Danilo Halytsky, King of the state of Halych-Volhynia, in honor of his son Lev. After the death of Danilo, Lev made Lvov the capital of Halych-Volhynia. Since the beginning of its existence, this city has become the cultural capital of the western Ukrainian lands. The history of Lvov is very rich and is linked to the history of many cities and empires  where history meets modern architecture. In order to gain many ideas, you will not need a tour guide. The only thing you need is to start with a tour of the old part of Lviv (Lvov). Chernihiv The city of Chernihiv is located on the banks of the Desna River and is considered among the oldest and most beautiful Ukrainian cities. It is distinguished by its charming nature and the presence of many tourist and archaeological attractions dating back to the seventh century. The most famous of these places are the Catherine Church and the church located in Red Square.
